summary: MCP work-record evidence and review-result recording tools.

tools.notes: Agent-safe MCP route for persisting graph-impact derived evidence onto a WK or slice. Resolves the workspace through configured aliases; rejects caller-supplied filesystem roots and shell output as authority. The graph_impact payload must be an envelope produced by the workspace code-index graph-impact surface (graph_impact_paths or graph_impact_diff), and the persisted entry is validated against the work-record schema before writing. Compact by default; verbose:true for raw graph_state and full derived evidence.

Agent-safe MCP route for recording bounded review-attestation evidence onto a WK or slice after a trusted findings-only reviewer or redteam run. Binds the selected unit to the canonical record and source_digest and derives review facts from launcher/backend-minted run status, not caller prose, shell output, or raw final_result bodies. Records evidence only: it does not write accepted_authorities[], does not locally convert needs_review to admit, and does not replace Chassis Control Engine admission-time review validation.

Agent-safe MCP route for recording coordination-only review-result evidence onto a WK or slice when a trusted reviewer or redteam run yields `changes_requested` role-result evidence or structured missing-result/runtime-failure evidence. Keeps this surface distinct from accepted/no-findings review attestation and from completion-satisfying review evidence. Binds the selected unit to the canonical record and source_digest and derives facts from launcher/backend-minted run status, not caller prose, shell output, or raw final_result bodies. Records evidence only: it does not write accepted_authorities[], does not locally convert needs_review to admit, and does not replace Chassis Control Engine admission-time review validation.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that creates (births) a new decision (`DEC-*`) record through the shared allocator/birth path (no caller-supplied filesystem root). The new DEC is born status='proposed', seeded to its decision.v1 required fields, and written as canonical `.json` with the `.md` projection in lockstep; returns the compact born-record envelope. Identity/provenance is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: agents DRAFT decisions but cannot ratify - `create` mints a `proposed` DEC and `amend` edits a `proposed` DEC, neither can set `status`; making a decision binding (`proposed`->`accepted`) is a HUMAN-ONLY operator action (the `wiki decision ratify` CLI once it ships; operator-only in the interim), not an agent tool. To get a decision ratified, finish the `proposed` draft and ask the operator to ratify it.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that amends one declared body section (`section`/`value`) of a decision (`DEC-*`) record by id through the validated kind-record persistence path, honoring an optional expected_source_digest for stale-write protection. Identity is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: agents DRAFT decisions but cannot ratify - `amend` edits a `proposed` DEC and cannot set `status`; making a decision binding (`proposed`->`accepted`) is a HUMAN-ONLY operator action (the `wiki decision ratify` CLI once it ships; operator-only in the interim), not an agent tool. To get a decision ratified, finish the `proposed` draft and ask the operator to ratify it.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that amends one controlled top-level scalar field (`field`/`value`) of a decision (`DEC-*`) record by id through the validated kind-record persistence path, honoring an optional expected_source_digest for stale-write protection. Lifecycle/provenance-managed fields (status/ratified/updated) are refused; identity is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: agents DRAFT decisions but cannot ratify - `amend` edits a `proposed` DEC and cannot set `status` (the `status`/`ratified` fields are refused); making a decision binding (`proposed`->`accepted`) is a HUMAN-ONLY operator action (the `wiki decision ratify` CLI once it ships; operator-only in the interim), not an agent tool. To get a decision ratified, finish the `proposed` draft and ask the operator to ratify it.

Operator-only human ratification action that flips a decision (`DEC-*`) record `proposed`->`accepted` by id, stamping who/when provenance through the validated kind-record persistence path and honoring an optional expected_source_digest. DEC-0152 posture: this is a HUMAN-ONLY action - agents are denied by the session-role access policy (operator-only), and there is no agent ratify tool. It is being superseded by the `wiki decision ratify` CLI (WK-1512), which becomes the only path to `accepted`; an agent gets a decision ratified by finishing the `proposed` draft and asking the operator to ratify it.

Operator-only human action that unratifies a decision (`DEC-*`) record `accepted`->`proposed` by id, clearing the ratification provenance and stamping who/when through the validated kind-record persistence path, honoring an optional expected_source_digest. DEC-0152 posture: this is a HUMAN-ONLY action - agents are denied by the session-role access policy (operator-only), and there is no agent unratify tool. It is being superseded by the `wiki decision unratify` CLI (WK-1512); an agent that needs to revise an accepted decision asks the operator to unratify it back to `proposed`, then edits the draft via the agent create/amend tools.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that performs the single agent-legitimate decision (`DEC-*`) status transition `proposed`->`rejected` by id - an agent declining (rejecting) its own never-accepted draft - through the validated kind-record persistence path, honoring an optional expected_source_digest. It refuses any source status other than `proposed` (an agent cannot `reject` an `accepted` DEC as a backdoor unlock). DEC-0155 posture: DEC lifecycle authority is symmetric - agents own the `proposed` lane (create, edit every field/section, and this one `proposed`->`rejected` transition), while every transition conferring or removing `accepted` authority (ratify, unratify, and the retirement transitions superseded/expired/deprecated) stays human-only CLI. This is the ONLY agent-callable DEC status transition.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that creates (births) a new initiative (`IN-*`) record through the shared allocator/birth path (no caller-supplied filesystem root). The new IN is born as a draft, seeded to its initiative.v1 required fields, and written as canonical `.json` with the `.md` projection in lockstep; returns the compact born-record envelope. Identity/provenance is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: initiatives are out of scope for the DEC lockdown - agents keep drafting initiatives freely (initiatives stay agent-writable), and the DEC ratify/unratify human-only ratification does not apply to initiatives.

Identity is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: initiatives are out of scope for the DEC lockdown - agents keep amending initiatives freely (initiatives stay agent-writable), and the DEC ratify/unratify human-only ratification does not apply to initiatives.

Free-tier agent-callable MCP route that amends one controlled top-level scalar field (`field`/`value`) of an initiative (`IN-*`) record by id through the validated kind-record persistence path, honoring an optional expected_source_digest for stale-write protection. Lifecycle/provenance-managed fields (status/updated) are refused; identity is server-resolved (there is no actor input). DEC-0152 posture: initiatives are out of scope for the DEC lockdown - agents keep amending initiatives freely (initiatives stay agent-writable), and the DEC ratify/unratify human-only ratification does not apply to initiatives.
